bowl-amaranto-frutas.name: Amaranth Fruit Bowl
bowl-amaranto-frutas.description: A nutritious breakfast or snack based on amaranth, an ancient pseudocereal rich in complete proteins and iron. This recipe combines the soft texture of cooked amaranth with fresh fruits and crunchy nuts.

step1.title: Rinse amaranth under cold water
step1.description: Measure 1 cup amaranth and rinse in [fine mesh strainer](https://amazon.com/fine-mesh-stainless-steel-strainer) under cold water for 2 minutes.
step1.tip: This step removes any residual earthy flavor.

step2.title: In a pot, boil 2 cups of water
step2.description: In a [heavy-bottom pot](https://amazon.com/heavy-bottom-non-stick-pot), boil 2½ cups water with a pinch of salt.

step3.title: Add amaranth and cook on medium heat for 20 minutes until tender
step3.description: Add rinsed amaranth to boiling water, reduce to medium-low heat and cook semi-covered.

step4.title: Drain excess water and let cool slightly
step4.description: When amaranth has absorbed the liquid, remove from heat and let rest covered for 5 minutes.

step5.title: Cut banana into slices
step5.description: Peel banana and cut into 1 cm thick slices.

step6.title: Wash strawberries and cut in halves
step6.description: Meanwhile, wash strawberries in cold water and cut in halves with [paring knife](https://amazon.com/high-carbon-steel-paring-knife). Gently wash blueberries and select only the firmest ones.

step8.title: Decorate with fruits, nuts and cinnamon
step8.description: Decorate with fruits and sprinkle cinnamon.

step9.title: Drizzle with honey and add yogurt if desired

bowl-amaranto-frutas.history1: Amaranth has been cultivated and consumed by Mesoamerican civilizations for more than 8,000 years. The Aztecs considered it a sacred food and used it both for nutrition and religious ceremonies. This pseudocereal was so valued that it formed part of the tribute paid to the Aztec empire.
bowl-amaranto-frutas.history2: Unlike traditional cereals, amaranth contains all essential amino acids, making it a complete protein similar to meat or eggs. For this recipe, we recommend [certified organic amaranth](https://amazon.com/organic-premium-amaranth) that preserves all its ancestral nutritional properties.
bowl-amaranto-frutas.seo-title: Amaranth Fruit Bowl - High Protein and Iron Breakfast
bowl-amaranto-frutas.seo-description: Amaranth fruit bowl recipe with fresh fruits. Pseudocereal rich in complete proteins, iron and fiber for a nutritious breakfast.
